question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**damaged**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the consequences of erosion on farmland, so "damaged" is the most suitable word to describe the negative effect of erosion on the land.
 
• "Damaged" fits the context of land being harmed or degraded by erosion over time.
 
• Other options ("purified", "developed", "improved") do not fit the context, as they imply positive changes, whereas the passage focuses on the harmful effects of erosion.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Erosion of America's farmland by wind and water (1)_____ a problem since settlers first put the prairies and grasslands (2)______ the plow in the 19th century. By the 1930s, more than 282 million acres of farmland were (3) damaged__ by erosion. After 40 years of conservation efforts, soil erosion has (4)________ due to new demands placed (5)____ the land by heavy crop production.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Damaged" clearly conveys the idea of land being harmed or impaired by erosion, which aligns with the passage's focus on soil degradation.
 
• "Purified", "developed", and "improved" are all positive terms and are not suitable in the context of erosion, which is destructive to the land.
